title: The Lamps
text: I have asked the Admiralty for a living crew for the Grace. They say the bound are cheaper, never mutiny, and keep their stations as long as the stern-lantern is lit, and the lantern is lit as long as the Throne is. As long as. I have asked again.
note: Behind the shrine in the sea cave. The smugglers had used the back of it for a tide table.
where: The Gull Isles, the sea cave
